name: 78253 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78253 (San Antonio) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78253 (San Antonio) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78253 (San Antonio) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 5 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
